items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Well, that's what she called Cal. And Uncle Sylvester... I get a kick out, I close his records, and Sylvester B's on those albums

ctx.x: You don't need another person doing your own music.

Right. And I get there and finally I get a telephone call, maybe my daughter or this one or that one called. Daddy, what you doing? I said, I'm sitting here playing my records. Daddy, you're going to sit there and you're going to worry yourself by Uncle Johnny. Well, that's what she called Cal. And Uncle Sylvester, she said, why don't you come down here by me? I said, well, I'll be here, I'm going to take a little nap. Well, that's what she'd be worrying about, me worrying about them. But it isn't either, I get a…
It's not affecting you morally or anything like that. It's, it's the healthy thing called the rest.
